title: Set up a deliberate testing strategy for the pinboard-3 monorepo
description:
## Why

pinboard-3 currently has **zero test infrastructure** — no vitest, no Playwright, no `*.spec.ts`/`*.test.ts`, and no `test` script anywhere in `apps/` or `packages/`. CI (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`, job `check`) only runs lint + format:check + type-check + build. This is fine for two apps, but the monorepo is expected to host many finder apps over time, so the test strategy should be designed deliberately and once — not bolted on as a side effect of a feature.

This bead was split out of the translations work (`feat/primary-care-translations`) specifically so testing isn't decided "on a whim." Andy's call (2026-06-16).

## Scope to decide

- **Unit tests:** adopt vitest. Where does shared config live (root vs per-package)? How are pure-logic units tested across `packages/*` and `apps/*`?
- **E2E tests:** mirror what `phila-ui-4` does with Playwright, adapted for many apps (per-app specs, shared fixtures, base URL/config per app).
- **Turbo pipeline:** add a `test` task to `turbo.json`; decide caching/inputs.
- **CI:** add a test step (or steps) to `.github/workflows/ci.yml` `check` job; decide whether e2e runs on PR or only on `test`/`main`.
- **Conventions:** spec file location/naming, what's unit vs e2e, coverage expectations, how a new app inherits the setup.

## Already-prepared seams (low-hanging fruit once the framework exists)

The translations work intentionally built these as pure, isolated, easily-testable units — write their tests first when the framework lands:
- `mergeDeep` in `@pinboard/ui` — shared-vs-app message precedence (app wins).
- `useLocale` composable (primary-care) — locale resolution order (`?lang=` → localStorage → default `en`) and write-back.
- Locale key-parity — every locale has the same key set as `en`.

## Reference

- `phila-ui-4` already uses Playwright — study its config/structure as the starting point.
- Process: run through brainstorming → design → plan rather than ad-hoc.

title: Move @phila/phila-ui-* versions to pnpm.catalog
description:
# Move @phila/phila-ui-* versions to pnpm.catalog

## Why

Each package in the workspace currently pins `@phila/phila-ui-*` versions independently. Versions can drift between an app and `@pinboard/ui`, producing runtime errors like:

> `does not provide an export named 'CloseButton'`

Concrete instance (2026-05-27): `apps/primary-care-finder/frontend/package.json` was pinned to `@phila/phila-ui-button@2.2.3-beta.2`, but `packages/ui/package.json` was on `2.2.3-beta.3`. `SortPanel.vue` (in `@pinboard/ui`) imports `CloseButton`, which only exists in `beta.3`. Vite's `optimizeDeps` runs at the app root, sees the older pin, pre-bundles the older version, and serves a pre-bundle that doesn't have `CloseButton`. Bumped the app pin to `beta.3` as a one-off fix.

The skew is going to keep recurring as `@phila/phila-ui-*` packages are bumped — there's no single source of truth.

## What to do

Move every `@phila/phila-ui-*` version to `pnpm.catalog` in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`:

```yaml
catalog:
  '@phila/phila-ui-app-footer': 1.2.3-beta.3
  '@phila/phila-ui-app-header': 0.3.0-beta.9
  '@phila/phila-ui-bottom-sheet': 0.1.0-beta.7
  '@phila/phila-ui-button': 2.2.3-beta.3
  # ...etc
```

Then in each `package.json` that declares one, replace the version string with `"catalog:"`:

```json
"@phila/phila-ui-button": "catalog:"
```

Files to update:
- `packages/ui/package.json` — 12 phila-ui-* deps
- `apps/primary-care-finder/frontend/package.json` — 1 phila-ui-* dep
- `apps/oem-flood-finder/frontend/package.json` — 12 phila-ui-* deps

After: `pnpm install` to regenerate the lockfile.

## Verification

- `pnpm install` succeeds with no version conflicts in lockfile
- `pnpm dev:pc` and `pnpm dev:oem` both start without module-resolution errors
- `pnpm build` succeeds for all workspace packages
- Only one copy of each `@phila/phila-ui-*` package in `node_modules/.pnpm/` per version line (no duplicate hash variants)

## Out of scope

- Whether `@pinboard/ui` should re-export button components so apps don't need to depend on `@phila/phila-ui-button` directly. Decision deferred: keep direct deps in apps (clear intent), use catalog to prevent drift.
- Other (non-phila) shared deps like `vue`, `vue-router`, `@fortawesome/*` — could also move to catalog but not required to fix the drift problem.

## Requires

- pnpm 10+ (currently on 10.33.2 — fine)
